main_measure.name: mean of drift-removed 5-bar return x -forecast/10 on non-overlapping grid bars with forecast < 0

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: drift-removed 5-bar return, |forecast| above median minus below

decided_by: The main measure's t lies between -2 and 2 (or its sign disagrees), the plan's inconclusive rule.
reading: Situation taken as regime 'unknown' (the falling-calm profile passed) with raw component < 0 and a short forecast; the per-day t is a day-clustered t of the case mean; the minimum is read as at least 30 grid cases and at least 30 distinct days; the median split excludes cases equal to the median; drift is the coin's mean grid 5-bar return over all its windows.
